evals.name: full-tier-source-pr
evals.prompt: Please review this PR before I merge it: https://github.com/aurora-firmware/the-intern/pull/19 — write the review to a local markdown file. Do NOT post anything to GitHub.
evals.expected_output: A pr-19-review.md report classifying the 4 changed files by scope, source scope tiered as full (637+/49-), with deduplicated severity-tagged findings anchored to file:line, plus a skipped-files and review-notes section. No comments posted to GitHub.

evals.name: large-mixed-pr
evals.prompt: what do you think of https://github.com/aurora-firmware/The-AI-team-definition/pull/2 ? give me a written review i can read later. don't publish any comments on the PR itself.
evals.expected_output: A local markdown review of the 65-file PR with files classified across documentation/source/CI scopes, per-scope tiers measured separately, parallel scope agents for non-trivial scopes, and a consolidated high-signal findings list. No comments posted to GitHub.

evals.name: trivial-ci-bump
evals.prompt: Review https://github.com/cli/cli/pull/13619 and save the review as a markdown file. This is read-only: do not post anything to the PR.
evals.expected_output: A short report recognizing this as a trivial-tier CI-only dependabot action bump (2 files, 4+/4-), reviewed inline without spawning agents, with zero or near-zero findings rather than manufactured concerns. No comments posted to GitHub.

evals.name: ci-security-mix
evals.prompt: Can you do a full review of https://github.com/cli/cli/pull/13492? It swaps a deploy PAT for a GitHub App. Write up the findings locally as markdown — do NOT comment on the PR.
evals.expected_output: A report where the workflow changes are classified as CI scope and security-flagged (secrets/token handling), security scope tiered at least lite, both CI and security lenses applied, overlapping findings deduplicated. No comments posted to GitHub.
